description:
Title: App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run

If you want to participate at the Vienna Night Run, you need to select a starting block first.
After that, you run for 5km and measure the time.
If you can do it in less than 25 minutes, you are good.
If not, you need to train and check until you have achieved this goal.
After that, you can get your starting number.
Depending on when your work day ends, you have to find out whether you can go there from home, or need to leave directly from work.
If more than one hour is left between your starting time and the end of your workday, you can go there from home.
Else, you need to leave directly from work.
While running at the Night Run, you run and drink at the same time.
In the end, you receive your final running time.

Some of the above information you have to enter into the app, some of the information is collected by fitness gadgets.

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_MeasureQualificationTime" name="Measure the 5 km time"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Qualification" name="Is the time less than 25 minutes?"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QualificationPass" name="Less than 25 minutes" sourceRef="Gateway_Qualification" targetRef="Task_GetStartingNumber">

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QualificationFail" name="25 minutes or more" sourceRef="Gateway_Qualification" targetRef="Task_Train">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelMerge_RaceSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_TravelMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RaceSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RaceSplit_Run" sourceRef="Gateway_RaceSplit" targetRef="Task_RunNightRun"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RaceSplit_Drink" sourceRef="Gateway_RaceSplit" targetRef="Task_DrinkDuringRun"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Drink_RaceJoin" sourceRef="Task_DrinkDuringRun" targetRef="Gateway_RaceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RaceJoin_Collect" sourceRef="Gateway_RaceJoin" targetRef="Task_CollectFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Receive" sourceRef="Task_CollectFinalTime" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_End" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" targetRef="EndEvent_FinalTimeReceived"/>
